description:
Sales Development Representative - Intern (Placement)
This role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.
Who We Are:
Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.
Job Description:
Location: Manchester, UK / On-site
Role: Sales Development Representative (SDR)
Start Date: 1st July 2027
About the Role
Hewlett Packard Enterprise is looking for an ambitious, commercially minded Sales Development Representative to join our Digital Sales organisation.
As an SDR, your primary mission is simple: create qualified sales pipeline through high-quality outbound prospecting.
You will identify and engage prospective customers, uncover business and technology challenges, develop relationships with key decision-makers and create new opportunities for HPE's Digital Sales teams.
This is not simply a high-volume calling role. We are looking for individuals who are curious about our customers, confident engaging senior stakeholders and capable of turning research, insight and conversations into meaningful commercial opportunities. The role provides an excellent foundation for someone looking to build a career in technology sales and progress into a customer-facing sales position within HPE.
What you’ll need:
Potential interns must be in their 2nd year of a four-year degree which requires (or has an option for) 3rd year to be a one year's industrial placement
On track to achieve 2:1 or above
You must be eligible to work in the UK and be available to commence the placement at the beginning of July 2027 for 13 months.
Keen to develop your skills and interested in building a career in technology sales.
What You'll Do
Generate Qualified Pipeline
Proactively identify and engage new prospects across HPE's target accounts.
Create qualified sales opportunities for the Digital Sales organisation.
Take ownership of pipeline generation targets and consistently work towards achieving them.
Qualify opportunities based on customer need, business impact, stakeholders, timing and potential commercial value.
Work closely with Digital Sales representatives to ensure opportunities are effectively transitioned and progressed.
Execute High-Quality Outbound Prospecting
Conduct consistent outbound activity across telephone, email, LinkedIn and other digital channels.
Develop personalised outreach rather than relying solely on high-volume generic messaging.
Research target organisations, industries and stakeholders ahead of engagement.
Use customer news, strategic priorities, technology trends and market events to create relevant reasons to engage.
Engage customers with curiosity and a consultative mindset.
Identify business challenges, technology priorities and potential areas where HPE can add value.
Build relationships across multiple stakeholders within target organisations.
Develop an understanding of how technology decisions are made within enterprise and commercial customers.
Capture high-quality information that helps the wider account team progress each opportunity.
Partner with Digital Sales
Work closely with Digital Sales Account Managers to understand their territories, priority accounts and pipeline requirements.
Agree target account lists and prospecting strategies with sales representatives.
Collaborate on account plans and whitespace opportunities.
Provide regular insight on prospect engagement, market trends and customer feedback.
Maintain clear ownership and communication throughout the opportunity handover process.
What Success Looks Like
Success in this role will be measured primarily by the quality and value of pipeline created, supported by leading activity and conversion indicators.
Key measures could include:
Qualified pipeline created
Number of qualified opportunities generated
Pipeline accepted and progressed by Digital Sales
Outbound customer conversations
New stakeholders engaged
Meetings generated from outbound prospecting
Prospect-to-opportunity conversion
Opportunity progression and conversion
Coverage across priority accounts
Consistency and quality of CRM data
The objective is not simply to generate activity. Successful SDRs create opportunities that convert into real sales pipeline and ultimately revenue.
Skills & Experience
Previous technology sales experience is not essential.
We are particularly interested in candidates who can demonstrate:
Strong verbal and written communication
Confidence communicating by telephone
Excellent interpersonal skills
Commercial awareness and curiosity
Strong organisational and time-management skills
Ability to research organisations and stakeholders
Ability to work towards measurable goals and targets
A willingness to learn about enterprise technology
Resilience and a strong work ethic
A growth mindset and desire to develop a career in sales
What you can expect from us:
A competitive salary
A central Manchester office location
Diverse and dynamic work environment
Work-life balance and support for career development
An amazing life inside the element!
#unitedkingdom #intern

What We Can Offer You:
Health & Wellbeing
We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing.
Personal & Professional Development
We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.
Unconditional Inclusion
We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.

We also never request personal information such as back account details, Social Security numbers, or national IDs via social media or chat applications.
All legitimate job opportunities will come through official company channels, and candidates are responsible for verifying the credentials of any third party claiming to represent the company. If you suspect recruitment fraud, do not share personal information or make any payments and report the incident to your local authorities immediately.
